sourceRefs.locator: Place of issue, two possessions, cartulary transmission and the closing formula dating by Carloman and Pippin. Different editions assign different days early in 743.
Section Childerich III, pp. 209–211, especially points b–f: the Soissons capitulary, the Wissembourg charter, the ninth regnal year on the Attigny original and the change of dynasty.
p. 123, section 3 and notes 80–82: Grimhild’s property, intention, request for the charter and first place in the witnesses. The study follows the January dating.

note.de: Ausstellungsort der Urkunde im Jahr 743, überliefert in einer Abschrift.
note.en: Place of issue of the 743 deed, preserved in a cartulary copy.

note.de: Grimhilds Urkunde nennt Weißenburg. Ihre beiden Güter werden bei Weitbruch und Herrlisheim verortet.
note.en: Grimhild’s deed names Wissembourg. Its two properties lay near Weitbruch and Herrlisheim.
